- [John Jumper leaves DeepMind for Anthropic](https://news.google.) — the AlphaFold architect's move could accelerate Anthropic's push into scientific AI and deepen the rivalry with Google.
- [China will have a Fable 5-class AI model before Q1 2027](https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/artificial-intelligence/elon-musk-says-that-china-will-have-a-fable-5-class-ai-model-probably-q1-next-year-ceo-of-chinese-anthropic-rival-says-it-wont-take-that-long) — Elon Musk and a Chinese AI CEO both predict rapid progress, intensifying the US-China AI competition.
- [Jane Street seizes AI spotlight](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/jane-street-ai-wall-street-bdfcc81a) — the secretive Wall Street powerhouse is applying AI trading strategies, signaling that financial AI is becoming a major frontier.
- [How to learn Iraqi Arabic (2020 pre AI)](https://medium.com/@xavierbisits/how-to-learn-iraqi-arabic-bd468eff29e5) — a quirky Hacker News find, but highlights the lingering value of pre-AI language resources amidst the AI boom.
- [Open-source AI agent OS AgentArk](https://github.com/agentark-ai/AgentArk) — a new self-hosted agent operating system aims to give developers control over autonomous agents.

Closing: The Jumper departure could trigger a talent cascade, while the race for next-gen models between the US and China is accelerating — expect significant model releases in the next six months.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
HackNews社区今日热议焦点：编程的本质是解决问题而非完成任务；GPS干扰规模惊人；经典游戏作曲家Bobby Prince逝世；法庭记录应免费开放；以及趣味性的香蕉车。

- **Kent Beck：我们不是雇你来完成任务**：这位知名程序员在newsletter中强调，开发者的价值在于创造而非机械执行（[点此](https://newsletter.kentbeck.com/p/hey-n00b-we-didnt-hire-you-to-complete)），获133点与65评论。
- **GPS信号篡改远超预期**：卫星数据揭示全球GPS干扰程度比想象严重许多（[Space.com](https://www.space.com/space-exploration/satellites/its-quite-a-more-than-we-expected-satellite-reveals-immense-scale-of-gps-signal-tampering)），引发安全担忧。
- **Doom作曲家Bobby Prince去世**：享年66岁，其作品定义了90年代游戏音景，获288点悼念（[Legacy.com](https://www.legacy.com/legacy/robert-bobby-prince-lll)）。
- **EFF呼吁法庭记录免费**：认为付费查阅司法文件损害公众知情权，获311点支持（[EFF](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/court-records-should-be-free)）。
- **Ask HN：内存短缺会倒逼高效代码吗？**：社区讨论引起60点关注，98条评论，与Nothing取消CMF手机形成现实注脚（[HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48604232)）。

社区整体情绪从反思编程方法论，到关注基础设施安全、开源文化传承与数字权利，呈现技术人文主义姿态。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community mourned the loss of a gaming icon, debated the true purpose of software engineering, and rallied behind free access to court records. The top-voted stories reflect a mix of nostalgia, introspection, and activism.
- [Bobby Prince, composer for Doom and Duke Nukem 3D, has died](https://www.legacy.com/legacy/robert-bobby-prince-lll) — the legendary composer passed away, earning 288 points and 32 comments, as the community remembered his iconic soundtracks.
- [Hey, n00b, we didn't hire you to complete tasks](https://newsletter.kentbeck.com/p/hey-n00b-we-didnt-hire-you-to-complete) — Kent Beck's essay challenging the “task completer” mindset resonated with 133 points and 65 comments, sparking discussion on engineering culture.
- [Court Records Should Be Free](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/court-records-should-be-free) — the EFF's call achieved 311 points and 66 comments, highlighting strong community support for open access to legal documents.
- [Zenzizenzizenzic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zenzizenzizenzic) — a Wikipedia page about an obscure mathematical term (square of squares) garnered 93 points, showing the community's love for esoteric knowledge.
- [How to feed a dictator](https://www.theguardian.com/film/2026/jun/09/how-to-feed-a-dictator-film) — a Guardian documentary review on films about authoritarian regimes earned 112 points and 39 comments.

Closing: The mix of mourning, philosophical debate, and advocacy underscores the Hacker News community's role as a barometer for tech culture — expect continued discussion on engineering ethics and public access to information.

足球.zh:
世界杯小组赛进入白热化：阿尔米隆因新规“捂嘴”吃到历史首张红牌，规则争议再起；巴西3-0胜海地但场面缺乏说服力，与阿根廷、法国形成对比；苏格兰0-1负摩洛哥遭遇点球误判，出线希望渺茫。英格兰方面，萨卡大概率不会首发对阵加纳，图赫尔暗示轮换。

- [阿尔米隆创世界杯“捂嘴”红牌先例](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cvg58m7n1plo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 红牌判罚瞬间引发球员和教练组强烈质疑。
- [巴西仍未展现冠军相](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c4gy8lldwqyo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 尽管3-0赢球，但进攻效率低下，中场控制力不足。
- [苏格兰点球被无视](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c3vydkrd5dvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 主裁判至少漏判两个点球，且未对摩洛哥球员红牌，苏格兰媒体赛后炮轰。
- [萨卡预计替补](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/crm0kg22m9jo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 英格兰队医谨慎处理其体能，加纳之战将测试替补深度。

世界杯小组赛第二轮已现多场争议判罚，VAR使用标准和新规执行力度成为后续赛事最大不确定因素；巴西的“沉睡”状态若持续，淘汰赛恐遭强敌狙击。
足球.en:
The World Cup headlines the football desk, with two major talking points: Miguel Almiron's historic red card for covering his mouth under new FIFA rules, and Scotland's controversial 1-0 loss to Morocco where they were denied two penalty claims. Brazil's lackluster form persists despite a 3-0 win over Haiti, while England's Bukayo Saka is unlikely to start against Ghana. Additional coverage includes a profile of Alex Freeman, son of a Super Bowl winner, stepping into the spotlight with the US national team.

- **[Almiron first player sent off for covering mouth](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cvg58m7n1plo)** – The red card sets a precedent for the new rule, with Paraguay's midfielder dismissed in the match against Turkey.
- **[Penalty controversy as Scotland punished by early Morocco strike](https://www.skysports.com/football/scotland-vs-morocco/report/549795)** – Scotland's World Cup hopes suffer a blow; debate over refereeing decisions continues.
- **[World Cup still waits for real Brazil to show up](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c4gy8lldwqyo)** – Brazil's performance against Haiti was dominant on paper but lacking in spark, raising concerns ahead of tougher opponents.
- **[England winger Saka unlikely to start against Ghana](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/crm0kg22m9jo)** – Thomas Tuchel hints at resting the Arsenal star, with implications for England's attack.
- **[The Super Bowl winner's son stepping into spotlight with USA](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/ckg4qvedjkwo)** – Alex Freeman looks to forge his own path in football, stepping out from his father's shadow.

Stay tuned for England's match against Ghana and the ongoing World Cup group stage battles.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
虎扑今日热度集中在“天赋”话题：亚马尔父亲称儿子只开发了20%潜力，引发对15岁新星上限的疯狂猜测；库尼亚双响获9.8评分印证其世界杯表现；马龙结束12年队长任期，社区涌现致敬帖。此外美国中卫理查兹138传仅丢1次的数据帖成为战术讨论焦点。

- [亚马尔父亲：他还没有发挥20%潜力](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOREVVc2Zoc0lYM1N5Qmc1QU1ZcDFHNzI4NDlZRzU2RnF2ME03SW80Wm5NcEFGZUxqcGFweXN1SGxydnVFNEJESGxRM0U2b0JsbkJRRHBPX2ZPdUJBUGJyQ0JxR3g1WUxoTHU2cVprVW1aSFFvbGQ2ejRReTQ0M1lMOFJaeDZMOWtWSTAySzVmSXl6cU83cllj) — “未来金球”讨论帖下回复量激增。
- [库尼亚双响，虎扑评分9.8](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPWUxNYVJ0VEk2NlpjWGtlSHBFcXFjQXZFU3phNGxzQlNUQ3pEeDlXaFpyc1FvM2l3V2J4OWN0MWtjYUtxNDJ4OTlzcUY2RU5DOVRRM2F1UFRuWGRScHVLS1E0RzZWSXk5QXM0NmZsVWw2VXp3MkZURnR6UjBsWF90OG9SZ05WbEgtU2RWQkwtaktadGc) — 球迷称其“身价再涨2000万”。
- [马龙结束12年队长任期](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFA3TERBQUk5MHdhVXI0ZW1YZkVPcDhGNlFHbzk4a1ZWTTEyaTFLSHNLdHVHbFBlbXZobmo3MXZReExSM3gyVGk0ZVY5TWx1eTBMaVpmclJ1Qll6aHkybGNidC1VbG9zVG11Ry15bDJZWkxmZw) — 评论区刷屏“龙队辛苦了”。
- [美国中卫理查兹138传仅丢1次](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBQcEx6WnVWaTNya05oa2RrV0NEX0pmRUJLTEtmcHN4M1hxdnRlck9PdUxRR0tnZlBQTDZjQWRXcDdiMDNWQmM4cjNRZW8zdWNacFNzN1lB) — 数据帖展现其出球能力，成为美国队后防基石。

亚马尔的话题预计将持续发酵，直至世界杯结束；马龙退役象征国乒一个时代的终结，新队长的产生将引向队内竞争格局。
虎扑社区动态.en:
The Hupu community is buzzing with a mix of football, basketball, and general sports discussions. A standout post features Lamine Yamal's father claiming his son has only shown 20% of his potential, sparking widespread debate. In basketball, Matheus Cunha's two goals earned a 9.8 Hupu rating, while US defender Richards' near-perfect passing stats caught attention. Additionally, Ma Long's 12-year captaincy of the Chinese table tennis team has ended, with praise for his leadership.

- **[亚马尔父亲：我儿子无需跟任何人比较，他还没发挥20%潜力](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOREVVc2Zoc0lYM1N5Qmc1QU1ZcDFHNzI4NDlZRzU2RnF2ME03SW80Wm5NcEFGZUxqcGFweXN1SGxydnVFNEJESGxRM0U2b0JsbkJRRHBPX2ZPdUJBUGJyQ0JxR3g1WUxoTHU2cVprVW1aSFFvbGQ2ejRReTQ0M1lMOFJaeDZMOWtWSTAySzVmSXl6cU83cllj)** – Yamal's father downplays comparisons, fueling fan excitement about the young star's ceiling.
- **[库尼亚打进两球，赛后收获9.8的虎扑评分！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPWUxNYVJ0VEk2NlpjWGtlSHBFcXFjQXZFU3phNGxzQlNUQ3pEeDlXaFpyc1FvM2l3V2J4OWN0MWtjYUtxNDJ4OTlzcUY2RU5DOVRRM2F1UFRuWGRScHVLS1E0RzZWSXk5QXM0NmZsVWw2VXp3MkZURnR6UjBsWF90OG9SZ05WbEgtU2RWQkwtaktadGc)** – Cunha's performance earns near-perfect rating from Hupu users.
- **[美国中卫理查兹前135分钟进行了138次传球，只传丢了1次](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBQcEx6WnVWaTNya05oa2RrV0NEX0pmRUJLTEtmcHN4M1hxdnRlck9PdUxRR0tnZlBQTDZjQWRXcDdiMDNWQmM4cjNRZW8zdWNacFNzN1lB)** – US defender Richards' impressive passing accuracy highlights defensive solidity.
- **[红星新闻：马龙结束12年队长任期，任期内以身作则](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFA3TERBQUk5MHdhVXI0ZW1YZkVPcDhGNlFHbzk4a1ZWTTEyaTFLSHNLdHVHbFBlbXZobmo3MXZReExSM3gyVGk0ZVY5TWx1eTBMaVpmclJ1Qll6aHkybGNidC1VbG9zVG11Ry15bDJZWkxmZw)** – Table tennis legend Ma Long steps down as captain after 12 years, earning respect across the community.

Keep an eye on Hupu for real-time fan reactions as the World Cup and Chinese sports events unfold.

篮球.zh:
NBA休赛期球星动态：扎克·拉文携妻子亮相世界杯看台，为美国队助威；国内篮球则因朱芳雨“吃篮球”趣味挑战、孙悦郭艾伦助阵高校总决赛而增添娱乐色彩；少年CBA乌鲁木齐赛区开赛，基层篮球热度不减。其余多为体育平台广告，信息价值有限。

- [拉文现身世界杯赛场](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBSaDRTcGlpUDRKakVKUE5QYmxuY1kxekhSdFVKeGZldUtOdlJ3Z1FIVFFocDJfWnVrYl8wbnlDZkJ0ZWlTdmF4REdrZUN2QzM4a0tPSnRB) — 拉文休赛期仍保持曝光，其交易流言市场或因此升温。
- [朱芳雨趣味赛输球吃篮球](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE5ZRk4wb2tyTmlWTGZnb2JsQlpxcVpTcmdEUWYwYnBnZUJwZkZKcFI0Mm5xanZkaW01d2Y1MzE2T2RSQkxRazNNNzU4VUljUDQwN2dIRHg1dUJfUGtmaDlnc21HZUtvWHNLVlpwdDBZdktVRWM) — 广东队总经理兑现诺言，事件在社交媒体传播，展现篮球圈娱乐化一面。
- [少年CBA乌鲁木齐赛区开幕](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPVnpCUzFFWTRCMGlGdDBiUkZWOTR6VHpaczZoZXhnZVN3bmk1N0lBcWtVNDNjMWRwaE5DTWhPOFd0V242d2N1M1VQRFgyakt0dE5BX3p4TjFBamhSRFI1TkRCdVdXcTBDYXZWdERuTzl0bENRcUFSVHd0VWVyM09fT3BJOUk) — 青少年篮球赛事体系持续完善，为CBA输送人才。

NBA休赛期进入球星动态期，拉文、拉梅洛·鲍尔等潜在交易流言将是未来几天虎扑篮球区焦点；国内篮球转向娱乐化与青训并举。
篮球.en:
Basketball news in the past 24 hours is largely dominated by off-court activities and local events. NBA star Zach LaVine was spotted at the World Cup with his wife, drawing fan interest. In China, Zhu Fangyu entertained fans by eating a basketball after losing a fun contest, with Sun Yue and Guo Allen attending the university finals. Meanwhile, the '2026 Youth CBA' kicked off in Urumqi, highlighting grassroots development. Numerous platform promotional articles (ky sports, 明陞体育, etc.) also appeared but carry limited news value.

- **[NBA球星扎克-拉文携美艳妻子现身世界杯赛场，观战美国比赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBSaDRTcGlpUDRKakVKUE5QYmxuY1kxekhSdFVKeGZldUtOdlJ3Z1FIVFFocDJfWnVrYl8wbnlDZkJ0ZWlTdmF4REdrZUN2QzM4a0tPSnRB)** – LaVine's appearance at the USA match adds a celebrity touch to the World Cup.
- **[朱芳雨趣味赛输球兑现承诺吃篮球，孙悦郭艾伦助阵高校总决赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE5ZRk4wb2tyTmlWTGZnb2JsQlpxcVpTcmdEUWYwYnBnZUJwZkZKcFI0Mm5xanZkaW01d2Y1MzE2T2RSQkxRazNNNzU4VUljUDQwN2dIRHg1dUJfUGtmaDlnc21HZUtvWHNLVlpwdDBZdktVRWM)** – Former CBA star Zhu Fangyu's viral stunt highlights the entertainment side of Chinese basketball.
- **[少年逐梦 篮动天山！2026少年CBA乌鲁木齐赛区燃情启幕！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPVnpCUzFFWTRCMGlGdDBiUkZWOTR6VHpaczZoZXhnZVN3bmk1N0lBcWtVNDNjMWRwaE5DTWhPOFd0R242d2N1M1VQRFgyakt0dE5BX3p4TjFBamhSRFI1TkRCdVdXcTBDYXZWdERuTzl0bENRcUFSVHd0VWVyM09fT3BJOUk)** – Youth CBA tournament launches in Urumqi, indicating continued investment in basketball development.

With the NBA offseason underway, Chinese basketball scenes and celebrity appearances will remain the main focus until the next season begins.

羽毛球.zh:
澳门羽毛球公开赛进入半决赛阶段，国羽混双新星蒋振邦/魏雅欣（“丫邦组合”）直落两局击败对手，顺利晋级；而新加坡男单二号种子郑加恒则在复赛中止步，未能更进一步。

- [蒋振邦/魏雅欣挺进四强](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9aUkVESGlCUl9nZnNranFtbFZHOURZSFdlclFkVXhzbHNwQ2dZU3BEekhmTDk2T3VTWGNkSEpUbFo1ZUtDLUJKS09wNTR5dzVZVWxzamo3Y1F4ck42X295X200UQ) — 两人配合日渐默契，被视为国羽混双后继力量。
- [郑加恒止步复赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1yUk9oSDUtNDNYZWRuNDlrcEktZnV4MzB1aU1odkJjczlmcE5fckFjTmRZd2JzSE1hRHhrVnh0aWpsMExHWndsOHluVHdhRmZDMHdqa2FFcV95Tmc) — 作为二号种子出局，暴露其稳定性不足。

蒋魏组合半决赛对手实力强劲，若取胜将有望冲击冠军，进一步巩固其国羽重点培养地位；郑加恒出局则让新加坡男单突破之路暂遇挫折。
羽毛球.en:
The badminton desk reports action from the Macau Open (a BWF World Tour event). Chinese mixed doubles pair Jiang Zhenbang and Wei Yaxin (nicknamed '丫邦组合') advanced to the semifinals, continuing their strong form. Meanwhile, Singapore's men's singles second seed Zheng Jiaheng was eliminated in the quarterfinals, a notable upset. The BWF World Tour news feed also provided general updates.

- **[蒋振邦魏雅欣进四强](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9aUkVESGlCUl9nZnNranFtbFZHOURZSFdlclFkVXhzbHNwQ2dZU3BEekhmTDk2T3VTWGNkSEpUbFo1ZUtDLUJKS09wNTR5dzVZVWxzamo3Y1F4ck42X295X200UQ)** – Chinese mixed doubles duo reaches semifinals in Macau, keeping medal hopes alive.
- **[澳门羽球公开赛 我国男单2号种子郑加恒止步复赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1yUk9oSDUtNDNYZWRuNDlrcEktZnV4MzB1aU1odkJjczlmcE5fckFjTmRZd2JzSE1hRHhrVnh0aWpsMExHWndsOHluVHdhRmZDMHdqa2FFcV95Tmc)** – Singapore's second seed Zheng Jiaheng exits in the quarterfinals, a setback for his campaign.
- **[News - BWF World Tour](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE1WSVUtSnVhR2l5OWNiN3oydWJ5ak5JeG1zOXpGc1VGekxHS0huTjNrdzNlWDlvSU15MFRSclJMOXBvT3QtX193VE1tTUlRd2JKSkpUa2VCYkYtd1NZZDh3UlFMejdDdWhWcTIta0Z5OA)** – General BWF World Tour updates round out the day's coverage.

Follow the Macau Open semifinals for more action from the Chinese pair and other international players.

欧美.zh: 欧美板块今日被三大事件切割：票房破纪录、口碑分化与行业告别。**[《玩具总动员5》以1.6亿+美元开画碾压市场](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-toy-story-5-1236962629/)**，首日含提前场超7100万美元，无悬念创下年度最佳开画，表明合家欢IP在大银幕的统治力未减。但**[《超级少女》先期口碑“混合”](https://deadline.com/2026/06/supergirl-first-reactions-milly-alcock-jason-momoa-david-corenswet-1236963084/)**，米莉·阿尔考克与杰森·莫玛的个人演出虽受好评，整体评价却未达预期，6月26日公映后能否走出逆跌曲线是观察重点。里程碑式的人物是**[喜剧导演詹姆斯·布罗斯去世](https://deadline.com/2026/06/james-burrows-tributes-1236963019/)**，丽莎·库卓、特德·丹森等集体悼念，其《欢乐酒店》《老友记》等作品定义了美国电视喜剧黄金时代。此外，**[凯西·贝茨自曝曾把《水男孩》剧本扔进垃圾桶](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/kathy-bates-didnt-know-adam-sandler-waterboy-script-1236626445/)**，[**法姆克·詹森批评漫威未邀其回归《复仇者联盟：末日》**](https://deadline.com/2026/06/famke-janssen-marvel-made-mistake-avengers-doomsday-1236963165/)，两则片场轶事折射好莱坞演员选角机制的偶然性与权力博弈。收束判断：疫情后观众对“确定性IP”的偏好加剧，但《超级少女》的先期反响提醒片方：情怀与视觉奇观之外，故事本身仍是决胜关键。
欧美.en:
The Hollywood desk is packed with box office dominance and nostalgia. **Toy Story 5** is poised for a record-breaking $160M+ opening, the best in two years, while **Supergirl** premieres to mixed early reactions but high anticipation. The industry also mourns legendary sitcom director James Burrows and reflects on Kathy Bates’ early skepticism of Adam Sandler. Rising stars voice concerns about AI and industry expectations, and crossover soap ratings show strength.

- **[Toy Story 5](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-toy-story-5-1236962629/)** heading to $160M+ opening; $71M Friday (incl. $17.5M previews) — biggest since 2024, reviving Pixar’s theatrical dominance.
- **Supergirl** first reactions [mixed](https://deadline.com/2026/06/supergirl-first-reactions-milly-alcock-jason-momoa-david-corenswet-1236963084/), but praise Milly Alcock and Jason Momoa’s Lobo; David Corenswet’s Superman called “peak casting.”
- **James Burrows** (Cheers co-creator) dies at 85; Hollywood tributes [pour in](https://deadline.com/2026/06/james-burrows-tributes-1236963019/) from Ted Danson, Lisa Kudrow, Danny DeVito.
- **Kathy Bates** [reveals](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/kathy-bates-didnt-know-adam-sandler-waterboy-script-1236626445/) she threw *Waterboy* script in trash because she didn’t know Adam Sandler; almost passed on *Matlock* too.
- **Rising stars** from *Obsession*, *The Pitt*, *Hacks* [discuss](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/tonatiuh-darrell-britt-gibson-obsession-pitt-hacks-euphoria-1236786154/) navigating AI and industry expectations at SAG-AFTRA First Act event.

This desk signals a strong summer movie season anchored by reliable IP, while behind-the-scenes human stories (Bates, Burrows) remind audiences of the personal journeys shaping entertainment.

日韩.zh: 日韩今日以K-pop长尾数据与限定团重生信号为主。**[TWICE《CHEER UP》MV油管破6亿](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849051wpp/twices-cheer-up-becomes-their-5th-mv-to-hit-600-million-views)**，成为组合第五首达到此里程碑的歌曲，标志二代团在全球流媒体的持久渗透力；而**[ENHYPEN前成员HEESEUNG以EVAN身份公布官方粉丝名“EVER”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849081wpp/evan-heeseung-announces-official-fan-club-name)**，SOLO企划正式启航，继承原团热度同时建立独立新身份。意外惊喜来自**[2017年选秀限定团UNB发布“REBORN·REBOOT·REUNITE”预告](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849027wpp/unb-hints-at-reunion-project-with-exciting-new-teaser)**，这是该团2019年解散后首次更新社交媒体，若成真将打破限定团“一次性”惯例，可能引发其他解散团队效仿。剧集方面，**[MBC《Fifties Professionals》收视刷新自身纪录达5.6%](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849075wpp/fifties-professionals-soars-to-its-highest-ratings-yet-my-royal-nemesis-heads-into-finale-at-no-1)**，而《我的王族宿敌》在终映前保持同时段第一，韩剧市场呈现“话题与收视分离”现象。收束判断：K-pop工业的“资源回收”能力——从二代团音源长尾到限定团重组——说明粉丝经济与怀旧情绪仍是当下最稳固的增长引擎。
日韩.en:
K-pop and K-drama continue to generate fan excitement. **TWICE** achieved a massive YouTube milestone, **EVAN** (formerly ENHYPEN’s Heeseung) launched his fan club name, and **UNB** unexpectedly teased a reunion. **8TURN**’s Kyungmin will sit out promotions due to health issues, while drama ratings hit new highs for *Fifties Professionals* and *My Royal Nemesis*.

- **[TWICE](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849051wpp/twices-cheer-up-becomes-their-5th-mv-to-hit-600-million-views)** “CHEER UP” MV surpasses 600M views, fifth MV to do so — iconic status cemented.
- **EVAN** (Heeseung) announces official fan club name [“EVER”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849081wpp/evan-heeseung-announces-official-fan-club-name), meaning “forever” — strengthening artist-fan bond.
- **UNB** [hints at reunion](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849027wpp/unb-hints-at-reunion-project-with-exciting-new-teaser) with “REBORN · REBOOT · REUNITE” teaser, first update since 2019.
- **8TURN**’s Kyungmin [to skip](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849020wpp/8turns-kyungmin-to-sit-out-upcoming-album-promotions-to-focus-on-recovery) upcoming album promotions due to gastric ulcer recovery.
- **Drama ratings**: *Fifties Professionals* [hits 5.6%](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849075wpp/fifties-professionals-soars-to-its-highest-ratings-yet-my-royal-nemesis-heads-into-finale-at-no-1), a new high; *My Royal Nemesis* heads into finale at No. 1.

Watch for UNB’s official confirmation and TWICE’s continued YouTube dominance — both could drive further nostalgia and streaming records.

微博社区动态.zh: 今日微博热搜被两波“端午节造型”和一期《歌手2026》直播细节霸屏。**[鞠婧祎晒出抱着超大型粽子的古装照，因“脸比粽子小”引发破圈热议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5ZTDVSckdPa014Zl80RUtEblBKeXgzLXM2MXF4U1pIcUprZDlieHFVMVE0SzFhSzhLb1NBVnE1alBFcG5nQnhTb2tSZEc2OXplVFpodlUzXzdHbVR5b1lmc2J6NF9icTB4THJkcHVwQU9aZw)**，讨论焦点从“精修图对比”延展至“女明星身材内卷”；**[唐嫣同期发布古风双面造型，被粉丝及营销号封为“古装天花板”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE5tdUh2R1ZWWUotTWJoVkdNdlpxWHFmb196LVFKaEx6Qm11Q0g4Qkl6M2pyMEJldWJSRWh5WjNTWG84NUJHYUlFSzYwcElQOVJReEhUbE42ZnI5VUE2YUZCQU5teXpVUEs3bGRJWE5ROWpzQkU)**，形成与鞠婧祎的间接“撞型”较量。另一热点是**[苏醒在《歌手2026》直播中左手胎记引发全网“防伪标识”讨论](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE16QVlscEwzOURrR0xnM3pTTndzX0taS3lqXy1zVTNodlAyanNuUFB1bUNfMkpocld5RTlvUTJMMUZFOWxLaUdoZm9nV0FaelJYcVB1WG5VejlxZjZmcXgza1V5emlZX3VrMVZxMGxjZjZzbkRWNDlFVW9Vdmp3QQ)**，老粉丝与新观众的态度分歧（“标志性特征”vs“手术疤痕？”）成为社交传播爆点。此外，**[陈瑶在《乘风》五公表演中穿白西装颠覆甜美形象直拍封神](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE4wMUhfcFlnd25iNHZia1hBcXNHNkFaNjA3ZmRDa1oyVU1NWWZqUUhMcnNXZFRrMU5OR1QyejQxMGJfRG9MUUpJak5LMnY4dmQyTDRjcjI1RDVnbTFuZVJRU2lLMkxQbVBnMC1OaWpTVmM)**，证明女团选秀仍有挖掘“反转型”人设的空间。收束判断：微博热点已高度依赖视觉碎片（造型对比、身体细节），明星团队主动制造“可讨论的细节”成为流量密码，但话题生命周期通常在24小时内。
微博社区动态.en:
China’s Weibo sphere is highly active with celebrity-centric stories. **Ju Jingyi**’s Dragon Boat Festival giant zongzi photo (face smaller than the zongzi) sparked viral comparisons and memes. **Su Xing**’s hand birthmark became a trending topic after a live performance on *Singer 2026*, leading to debates about authenticity among fans. **Chen Yao**’s white suit performance on *Chengfeng* wowed netizens, while **Bai Lu**’s photo count error — fans mistook 18 photos for 32 — also hit trending.

- **Ju Jingyi** [posts giant zongzi photo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5ZTDVSckdPa014Zl80RUtEblBKeXgzLXM2MXF4U1pIcUprZDlieHFVMVE0SzFhSzhLb1NBVnE1alBFcG5nQnhTb2tSZEc2OXplVFpodlUzXzdHbVR5b1lmc2J6NF9icTB4THJkcHVwQU9aZw) — face compared to zongzi size, generating thousands of shares.
- **Su Xing’s birthmark** [becomes hot topic](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE53bnBldk5zalJJZVUtZ3E4cHd3Tm8wMFNNRnprT1dhVVhtSWpiVXlUX3pHRFlWUFhOSzgxVk5PVkJQS3ctWDY0WDVEckhINE9rSVpCajh3NnJYUlExX1FxdUt6SkxoamdwNzBITWI3LVhVeGdFbkV6cW9VVFVGdw) after *Singer 2026* live show; older fans vs. new fans react differently.
- **Chen Yao** [stuns in white suit](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE4wMUhfcFlnd25iNHZia1hBcXNHNkFaNjA3ZmRDa1oyVU1NWWZqUUhMcnNXZFRrMU5OR1QyejQxMGJfRG9MUUpJak5LMnY4dmQyTDRjcjI1RDVnbTFuZVJRU2lLMkxQbVBnMC1OaWpTVmM) on *Chengfeng* — dubbed “A-list” performance, challenging her sweet image.
- **Bai Lu’s photo miscount** [goes viral](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFA4ejlYeUpMRnVnbmVTQkMxNjJaTElvaGU3aklQd1hGU1VRTGoyeVZZczFDVTdxa2VKN092NFdNdmZzN2VaalYzaDdrNi1sYXhzMzA2RUI3Zll0R3c1b1hqUnlSX2poMXRYeDZZYWRlVjctUQ) — fans thought she posted 32 photos, actually 18, sparking fan accountability discussions.

This desk reflects how minor celebrity details (birthmarks, food photos) can dominate Chinese social media, often driving engagement higher than formal industry news.

中国.zh: 中国区今日呈现文体跨界与行业自省并存的图景。**[李现以“世界杯开球嘉宾”身份亮相引发讨论](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE83ZlhSeFM4M05zUkF1LTJXeG9WckRnaHNLY1ZVbzNhTDhLaS04ZEVybEctb3FPcHRSblpKaVVJaUZLRG9WbW9EM0RTV3poSF9XbU91ZGJiOFJjRFdJSnZDN2puMG54bkNLT1lxdFNiNXlWUQ)**，虽然主流声音赞扬其“国际影响力”，但部分媒体质疑商业赞助性质，指出此身份并非官方FIFA大使，需厘清“受邀表演”与“官方嘉宾”的区别。同期红毯盛事“中国影视之夜”中，**[迪丽热巴以造型抢占头条](https://news.google.)**，展现顶流艺人在红毯经济的统治力。较具冲击力的是两则行业观察：**[《中国新闻周刊》报道“明星细胞存储”灰色产业](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9VRVFNY0xlSnVwUkRlRDlsekw1SEJhTVktdXBBNEs3TlB0SWdqLTJYZlpJUUNBZDg3RGxJSl9iVDBxdmJCMHlmc1N2VjFCRmt2TU1QcmJGVFNqdEZMaU5FcFFuUDZrS0xON1lRUnEzei1Idw)**，揭示高端抗衰老项目在明星圈盛行，价格“十几万元一次”，挑战公众对艺人道德示范的期待；同时**[“顶流明星求工作、横店群演惨状空前”言论在《人民报》传播](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE00TVR1SE1mV0gzUWNQMU1RcFRCRDNDVU5oQmJRSVNyaUg0M0RVdVBOMkp3aHltSXJsSFdUaWV5VEUwS1BIV1NZVTJKLVVCVjFRTjd0TVMwaEc5UGRxSjM0cERuYWFrdTJ1ejMwcA)**，折射影视行业整体收缩下的焦虑情绪。收束判断：内娱正处于“面子与里子撕裂”阶段——表面红毯光鲜、跨界破圈，底层却面临项目减少、收入锐减的寒冬，公众对明星“高收入不匹配社会责任”的质疑恐将继续发酵。
中国.en:
Chinese entertainment news covers cross-industry moves, red carpet fashion, and industry health. **Li Xian** was invited as a World Cup kickoff guest, raising questions about Chinese stars’ global sports influence. **Di Li Reba** dazzled at the China Film Night red carpet, while a controversial article compared Korean stars’ pandemic donations unfavorably to Chinese stars. **Busan International Film Festival** announced Asian Content Awards nominees with Chinese actors included. A report on stars storing cells for anti-aging treatments and a piece on the struggling Hengdian film industry also surfaced.

- **Li Xian** [as World Cup kickoff guest](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFBFMVk4Q1cxTTBBLWt3N0pvanYyNlFCQW82alBKSm84Tm90djlRUFFZS0hmdlQ0NEpGSHpVZzZILU9tcGRyNUwtenBjWC1FRDdmTFlCZGtvdVB3bmZ0ZEdGZEpiMGZiOVRMVmd0SGRfaHo) — discussion on whether this signals rising Chinese star influence in global sports.
- **Di Li Reba** [dominates red carpet](https://news.google.) at China Film Night — praised as top-tier star power.
- **Korean vs. Chinese star donations** [sparks debate](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE00T3U5cVl2bnU4Q2JIUGtXUFlRbjNnYXZHclhvUzJGNWRLMEZiMVZNTTBuRklwc1NfUUZjNUJuLW9lZzlRQ254QlJTdHNmT2Z4a010Rw) — article claims Korean stars donated more during pandemic, criticizing Chinese celebrities.
- **Busan Asian Content Awards** [nominees include Chinese actors](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1tLUdEdmJVNGpwVV9sTHRPTS1kdFZtZEl4RmlPMGY0WVNGRFIwWnQzT3lXdEVseDlGVkZVRWlfdmx2YkZrNmRWQjAxOUJnWU1xbko4bEttVWdaRk55QW03WHJxUEp4eEdpQnk5SXZpc3c) — adds cross-border recognition.
- **Hengdian film industry [struggles](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE00TVR1SE1mV0gzUWNQMU1RcFRCRDNDVU5oQmJRSVNyaUg0M0RVdVBOMkp3aHltSXJsSFdUaWV5VEUwS1BIV1NZVTJKLVVCVjFRTjd0TVMwaEc5UGRxSjM0cERuYWFrdTJ1ejMwcA)** — report says top stars begging for work, extras in dire conditions.

This desk shows a mixture of optimism (Li Xian, Di Li Reba) and caution (donation comparisons, industry slump), reflecting the uneven health of China’s entertainment ecosystem.
